extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels and large backdrops. Works with every video add-on: any add-on folder can be a row on Home, with trailers on posters, a full info page, a calendar, sport and live TV.

Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen en grote achtergronden. Werkt met elke video-add-on: elke map van een add-on kan een rij op Home worden, met trailers op posters, een volledige infopagina, een kalender, sport en live tv.
extension.news: 1.42.0: Seven new views for series and episodes (List side menu > View). Series: Banner list (logo, how many episodes you saw, status), Progress rings (posters with a ring) and Mosaic (the chosen series big, the others as tiles). Episodes: Timeline (big stills on a line with dots for what you saw), Episode cards (two columns), Up next stack (with the reason, like where you stopped) and List with flags (4K, HDR, sound, subtitles). Music: Vinyl (a record turns slowly next to the sleeve, not in light mode), Artist wall, Album with track list, Coverflow and Discography timeline. Film series: Collection shelf. Everything: Recently added. The side menu now opens from every new view (Left on the first item) and Right goes back. 1.41.1: Clean-up: for films and series Lucent offers Lucent Video and the folders of your own add-ons; the extra settings, buttons, setup step and texts for one other video add-on are gone. The hint on the season page now simply says OK: play. 1.41.0: Four new views for films and series: Spotlight, Wall with info panel, Carousel and Title card (List side menu > View). A trailer on Home now plays only once per title until Kodi starts again. The calendar bell is back on the season page for series from other add-ons that still get new episodes. New button in the player menu: What did they say? (10 seconds back with the subtitles on for a moment), with a video add-on that offers it. Add-on settings: the group headings are bigger, with more room above them. 1.40.3: New setting Watching > Close the player menu by itself: while a video plays, the player menu goes away after 3 to 15 seconds without a button press. While a video plays the skin does no background work beyond what is needed, so the box has everything for the picture. On CoreELEC the setup assistant warns when 'Adjust display refresh rate' is off (Dolby Vision needs it), and its button only switches it on. 1.40.2: Series page: the status of the series (Ended, Continuing, Cancelled, In production) is now also shown for series from add-ons and your Kodi library, and the text above the episodes tells what the chosen episode is about. 1.40.1: Scores with logos (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes fresh or rotten, RT audience, Metacritic, Letterboxd) in the lists and on the info page, via Skin settings > Rating logos > Fetch. 1.40.0: The settings screen of add-ons is new, in three columns: groups, settings and a card that explains the focused setting (for Lucent Video with a tile and picture per group). New icons of Lucent parts show as soon as Kodi starts again.
